content.short: SyncAI is an AI-powered DePIN network on Cardano for communication between users, dApps, and blockchains.
content.description: SyncAI describes itself as a unified communications network built on a user-centric architecture with abstract programming. The project is framed as an AI-powered DePIN network on Cardano that enables communication between users, decentralized applications, and blockchains. Its core pitch is to reduce friction in how different actors and systems exchange information across a web3 environment.
